notes: §12.1.5: "**Named arguments are required** at the call site when an `export`ed function has two **adjacent parameters of the same type** (K1104; the fix inserts the labels). `transfer(db, from: a, to: b, amount: x)` cannot be called with `from` and `to` swapped by position." §12.1.3: "**Arguments:** positional first, then named (`f(a, b, tax: 0.1)`). Any parameter may be passed by name." §12.1.4: default values are allowed. Positive twin: every argument of `transfer` is named.
